title: From Imaging to Insight: How the AI-integrated FLIM System Supports Precision Surgery
html:
At SurgicGuide, we believe that the future of cancer surgery is not only about seeing more — it is about understanding what we see in real time.

Our AI-integrated FLIM System combines fluorescence lifetime imaging with artificial intelligence to explore differences between tumour and normal tissue. By analysing fluorescence lifetime information alongside advanced imaging data, the system is designed to provide surgeons with additional information during tumour resection.

What makes this approach particularly interesting is the connection between photonics, biology, artificial intelligence, and clinical practice. Developing a technology like this requires more than a single discipline — it requires scientists, engineers, clinicians, regulatory specialists, and product developers working together.

From laboratory research and system development to clinical validation and regulatory planning, every step brings us closer to translating an innovative imaging concept into a technology that could support real-world surgical decision-making.

Our vision is simple: turn advanced imaging into actionable insight, and help make precision surgery more precise.

Advancing Precision. Guiding Surgery. Improving Outcomes.
